newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen Domenici sees stringent spending curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen Domenici sees stringent spending curbs.

text.p: U.S. Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said on Friday that he foresaw a very restrictive budget for fiscal 1998 unless President Bill Clinton agreed to cut entitlement programs further.
Domenici told Reuters Financial Television that Clinton should agree to bigger cuts in entitlement programs such as Medicare and Medicaid than he proposed in his budget.
If not, cuts in non-entitlement programs would have to be about twice what Clinton proposed and there would be no room for a tax cut.
